answer: Inter-Arrival Variance Gate. Each new identity must build a timing history whose request inter-arrival variance falls inside a per-class band; agents that emit suspiciously uniform or bursty traffic sit on an ivory watchlist. Sustained deviation pushes them toward a slow canyon of throttled queues. Cost: an attacker must synthesize plausible human-like timing jitter across many sessions per identity, wasting compute and wall-clock time at every vertex of the botnet.
